rationale: The implementation is correct and follows established appInfoStore conventions. Synchronous pre-assignment ensures AutoPopupManager backward compatibility. All error paths — including null response body, response.json() rejection, and network failure — are caught by the try/catch block and fall back to the static releaseNotes JSON dates. Four new tests cover the primary happy path, empty-deployments fallback, partial override, and network error. No blocking findings from either lens. Defer items noted: missing tests for implicit catch paths (null body, .json() failure, deployedAt type coercion), localStorage isolation gap in beforeEach. No spec artifact available (sdlc-light flow produces no spec.md); confidence is low because no acceptance criteria were audited.

standards_review.notes: EPMCDME-10701: Merge deployment dates into release notes from /v1/deployment-versions — matches required EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern
Uses api.get() + await response.json(); no .data accessor; API call inside Valtio store method — all consistent with api-integration.md

Silent try/catch with console.error and graceful degradation matches the established bootstrap-phase pattern in loadAppInfo(), fetchToolConfigs(), and fetchCustomerConfig(). No loading/error state exposed — consistent with existing appInfoStore convention.
No secrets, no injection vectors, no user-controlled data in the API call path. Raw error object passed to console.error is consistent with existing project patterns.
